title: Learning-module authoring
goal: Facilitator-created modules with draft/publish/archive workflow and explicit free or paid access terms.
acceptanceCriteria: A module can be saved as a draft; publishing requires a title, summary, at least one lesson and an explicit access/price policy. No payment is collected.
prototypeBoundaries: In-memory stores reset on process restart.
Demo actor headers are not authentication.
Do not claim live external integrations or real opportunities unless verified.
